## Synopsis

```text
perch account disable [OPTIONS]
```

## Description

Disable prevents new IMAP and submission logins without deleting messages. Use enable to reverse it.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--config <value>` | configuration file (default: ~/.config/perch/perch.yaml) |
| `--email <value>` | account email |
| `--help, -h` | show help |

## Examples

```sh
perch account disable --email you@example.com
```
